sloka: त्यागिनं सङ्ग्रहीतारं सानुक्रोशं यशस्विनम् ।सर्वे त्वामवगच्छन्ति ततः सम्बोधयाम्यहम् ।। ६.१२५.९ ।।
transliteration: tyāginaṁ saṅgrahītāraṁ sānukrośaṁ yaśasvinam ।sarve tvāmavagacchanti tataḥ sambodhayāmyaham ।। 6.125.9 ।।

translations.english: "O Ruler of men, all the army will desert a king who is devoid of virtues, lowly and who is a destructor in the battlefield."
